description: Annual formation transport periods is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). The transport periods indicate when the formation is valid. Referenced in the TP column for the annual formation - indicates no journey on this day x indicates a journey on this day The Version field distinguishes the different timetable periods. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Verkehr, Rollmaterial. The portal shows 2023-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
